transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Mitsuri. The report from the village states that seven homes were destroyed by the force of your Love Breathing during the battle. You know our rules about civilian protection. Why did you act with such force?

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Oyakata-sama, I... I am deeply sorry for the damage caused. The demon was a large Upper Rank, and I... I felt the need to end it quickly to protect the villagers. I... I did not mean to cause so much destruction.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
I understand the gravity of facing an Upper Rank, Mitsuri. Your dedication to protecting the villagers is without question. However, the Demon Slayer Corps exists to protect all life, not merely from demons, but from the collateral effects of our battles as well. Seven homes, Mitsuri. Seven families now without shelter, in addition to the terror they experienced.

Was there truly no other way to subdue this demon without such widespread destruction? We are trained to be precise, even in the most dire circumstances.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: You are right, Oyakata-sama. I... I was overzealous in my approach. I should have been more mindful of the surroundings and taken a more calculated strategy. I was so focused on the immediate threat that I failed to consider the broader impact of my actions. This was a grave oversight on my part, and I am truly remorseful for the distress I have caused the villagers.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:

What went through your mind in those moments that caused you to prioritize overwhelming force over precision? Was it a lapse in judgment, or a fundamental shift in your combat philosophy? We cannot afford such incidents to become a pattern. What will you do differently next time, not just to *try* to be more careful, but to *ensure* civilian structures are spared?

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text:
Oyakata-sama, I... I understand the gravity of this situation. My actions were not in line with the principles we hold dear. It was a combination of factors: the surprise of encountering a particularly large Upper Rank so close to the village, the urgency to protect the civilians, and... and perhaps a touch of pride in showcasing my full power to the demon.

I know now that such an approach is unacceptable. To ensure civilian structures are spared in the future, I will implement a pre-combat checklist to assess the area and potential impact of my Love Breathing. I will also train more extensively with Inosuke, who has a keen eye for environmental awareness. And... I will seek the guidance of other Pillars to incorporate their strategies for containing damage. I pledge to make this a top priority in my future missions.

transcript.speaker: antagonist

The true change must come from within, from a constant, unwavering awareness of your surroundings and the potential impact of your every move.

This incident is a reminder, even for a Pillar, that vigilance extends beyond the demon itself. It encompasses the entirety of the situation. I expect you to not only implement these new strategies but to internalize this lesson deeply. The lives and livelihoods of those we protect depend on it. Do you understand the true weight of this responsibility?
